lastReleaseMessage: The three stylesheets carry the build query the modules carry, the module-route note says the graph is whole, and the five hollow symbols record the solid file each was cut from

barRaise.topFinding: Every defect the morning review named is fixed and shipped, checked file by file tonight rather than taken from the commit messages: the default label follows the chamomile record with a test holding the two together, typing into a section title no longer destroys the focused input, the printed label takes the theme ink in place of the invisible gold, flushPrintStage runs before both print and export. All five test suites pass at v1.3.1. One closure did not hold. The duplicate-key guard written for data/aliases.json and the two maps in data/herb-to-illustration.json sits nested inside the herbs.json loop at test-data-integrity.mjs:450-458, so it runs only when herbs.json itself carries a duplicate top-level key, which it does not; the suite reports success without the scan having looked. An independent scan tonight found no duplicate keys in any of the three files, so the data is sound today, while the guard meant to catch tomorrow's is dead code.

barRaise.reconcileNote: Closed on verified evidence 2026-09-23: maintainability-06 (data/label-templates.js:61-71 describes the removal of the dead fields list accurately and cites PROJECT_SPEC.md section 4.7 at :139-160, which carries no such list). Deferred finding release-pipeline-gate-page-publish-02 also closed on evidence, outside the actionsClosed count because a deferred row is not an open action: X:/YesAndEverything/index.html:1829 and X:/YesAndEverything/projects/apothecary/index.html:102 both read v1.2.0 against the source pill at index.html:101, and the mirror is byte-identical across all 156 files. Re-verified as STILL TRUE rather than closed: reliability-04 (no timeout at src/util/export-png.js:27-45, no button disable at src/ui/editor.js:775-779), solo-tool-ux-01 (no tabindex and no keydown anywhere in src/ui/layout-designer.js), reliability-02 (the catch at scripts/discord-notify.ps1:126-129 sets no exit code and release.ps1:330-332 checks none, unlike steps 4 and 6), compliance-data-steward-04 (data/symbols/SOURCES.md:21-22 and :36-38 still unresolved, no credit in index.html or README.md), release-pipeline-version-pill-drift-02 (the writer never calls check-version-pill.ps1 at all, in any mode, which corrects the previous run's premise). The enqueue backfill for carried findings did not run, per the ruling of 2026-09-22 in DECISION_BATCH-2026-08-31.md item 0: build-aged-packets.py reads openFindings directly, so minting rows would put the same work in front of a session twice. Evening verification pass 2026-09-23 23:44 UTC, second firing of the rotating slot: every one of the nineteen action items in this morning's report was re-checked against the code at v1.3.1 (87687b7) rather than against its closure note. Eighteen hold on evidence; the five findings the morning note re-verified as STILL TRUE (reliability-04, reliability-02, solo-tool-ux-01, compliance-data-steward-04, release-pipeline-version-pill-drift-02) all shipped later the same day in v1.3.0. One closure is withdrawn: data-integrity-02 was logged closed on the claim that the duplicate-key scan covers data/aliases.json and both maps in data/herb-to-illustration.json, and the scan is dead code, nested inside the herbs.json duplicate loop at test-data-integrity.mjs:450-458 whose body never executes. Its closedLog entry is removed and the finding is re-filed as data-integrity-02-v2 with the new evidence. actionsClosed stays at 65, because that field is the cumulative count of everything ever closed and the status contract holds that it may rise and never fall; the withdrawal is carried by the reopened finding and by the missing closedLog entry, which is what the drain and the dashboard read. Health moves 78 to 85 and the verdict moves needs-attention to working: the four lens scores the morning report attributed to now-verified-fixed regressions are restored to the pre-regression values that report names (performance 58 to 89, print fidelity 58 to 90, palette discipline 58 to 82, dev-log notify wiring 45 to 85), and no other score was touched, because no lens was re-run. An independent duplicate-key scan of herbs.json, aliases.json and herb-to-illustration.json found none, so no data defect is hiding behind the dead guard.

test-data-integrity.mjs gained section 12b: every theme in use has its shopColor, latinColor and descColor checked against its own paperGradEnd at the same 4.5:1 bar the herb accent already met. Those three come from the theme rather than the herb, so one bad value is wrong on every label at once, which is worse than one herb reading poorly. Proved by making one bad on purpose: a lightened latinColor failed at 1.14:1 and the suite exited 1, and the file was restored and the suite passes.

src/main.js reads var(--warn) for the boot-failure screen instead of the #C4580A literal, which is exactly what --warn holds in styles/base.css. Two copies of one colour drift the day the token moves, and this is the screen nobody looks at until it matters.

The file-layout table in CLAUDE.md carries a row for every source file again. Five were missing, not the four the finding named: escape-html.js, resolve-illustration.js, saved-labels.js, suggest.js and truncate.js. Each description is read off the header the file already carried about itself rather than guessed, and a walk over src/ now finds no .js file without a row. Committed from the index rather than the working tree, so the uncommitted convention edit another session left in that file stayed theirs.

Every herb record drops the clinical register, 37 rewrites across four fields, and a gate in test-data-integrity.mjs refuses the twenty words the file actually carried. A source could not be added honestly: the text was written as flavour copy for a label designer rather than from a reference, and inventing a citation would be worse than the sentence it dressed up. So the finding's other half is the one taken, and what a plant is said to do stays while the drug class, the receptor and the mechanism go. Another session had started the same work on the compounds field and stopped, which is why its edits were sitting uncommitted; this finished the sweep across cautions, historicUses, desc and descFull as well. A scan for the register returns zero, and all five suites pass.
REDACTED: this text named a weakness and the file it lives in, which together are an address. Severity and project are kept; the location is in the project's own report under X:\PortfolioOps.
